item.text: {"claim_scores":[{"claim_id":"c1","score":"1","rationale":"It patches `litellm.text_completion` and drives `dspy.LM(\"openai/demo\", model_type=\"text\").forward(...)`, capturing the actual outbound text request path."},{"claim_id":"c2","score":"1","rationale":"It sets conflicting upper-case and provider-specific lower-case env vars, then asserts the first call uses `openai_API_KEY` and `openai_API_BASE` values."},{"claim_id":"c3","score":"1","rationale":"It makes a second call with explicit `api_key` and `api_base` kwargs and asserts those exact explicit values override env-derived ones."},{"claim_id":"c4","score":"1","rationale":"It records and prints captured outbound kwargs including `model` and `prompt`, which exposes the rewritten text model and assembled prompt shape."}],"question_score":100,"needs_regrade":false}
